core.navigation.modules.label: Modules
core.modules.title: Modules
core.modules.description: The parts of the platform this theatre can use. Open one for its settings. Switching a module off hides its screens and pauses its work; its data is always kept.
core.modules.group.always-on-help: The platform itself and the parts every theatre needs.
core.modules.group.available-help: Switched off. Switch one on to add its screens.
core.modules.group.own-help: Modules your theatre added to its own copy of the platform.
core.modules.experimental-note: Experimental: how it stores its data may still change before it is stable.
core.modules.deprecated-note: Deprecated: it will be removed in a later release.
core.modules.missing-secret: {name} is not set. Add it as a Worker secret in the Cloudflare dashboard; until then this module cannot work.
core.modules.missing-credential: {name} has not been entered. This module cannot work until it is.
core.modules.view-only: You can see which modules are on. Only the theatre's owner can switch them.
core.modules.dialog.also-on: These will be switched on with it, because it needs them:
core.modules.dialog.secret-blocks: It cannot be switched on until {names} is set as a Worker secret in the Cloudflare dashboard.
core.modules.dialog.no-screens: It adds no screens of its own.
core.modules.dialog.kept: Nothing is deleted. Its data is kept, its background work waits, and switching it back on brings everything back as it was.
core.modules.dialog.prevented.one: It cannot be switched off while {modules} needs it. Switch that off first.
core.modules.dialog.prevented.other: It cannot be switched off while {modules} need it. Switch those off first.
core.modules.about.unavailable: You cannot see this module's details.
core.modules.about.secrets-help: Worker secrets are set in the Cloudflare dashboard; credentials are entered in the app. Values are never shown.
core.modules.window.title: {module} settings
core.modules.window.description: The same settings as the module's page in Admin.
core.modules.window.none: There are no settings here you can change
